answer: Resist sybils with capped reputation inheritance: a new identity may inherit only a small, capped share of its sponsor's standing, like a single pearl passed down, never the whole chest. Inherited weight decays each epoch unless replaced by weight the identity earns itself through verified work. A sponsor's total inheritable budget is capped, so one backer cannot bankroll an army. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must either earn standing for each one, a long voyage of work, or bribe many sponsors, each a relic of hard-won trust, while an honest agent inherits once and earns the rest.
